semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For fixed integers a, b, r, j with 0 <= a <= b and r, j nonnegative, the set of pairs (S, lambda) satisfying the stated weight equation is finite, and the sum of (-1) raised to the size of S over all pairs in that set is exactly the number of pairs with S even minus the number of pairs with S odd.
quantifier_order: Fix integers a, b, r, j subject to 0 <= a <= b, r >= 0, and j >= 0.
Define I as the integer interval from a+1 through b.
For each pair (S, lambda), membership in X_j requires S to be a subset of I, lambda to be a finite multiset of elements of I, and wt(lambda) plus the sum over s in S of r+s to equal j.
Define E_j and O_j as the counts of pairs in X_j with even or odd size of S.
The alternating sum over all pairs in X_j equals E_j minus O_j.

witness_dependencies: There are no existential witnesses in the final conclusion.
Every pair (S, lambda) in X_j is determined by the fixed parameters a, b, r, and j through the equation wt(lambda) plus sum over s in S of r+s equals j.
E_j and O_j depend on X_j, hence ultimately on a, b, r, and j.
The alternating sum is taken over the finite set X_j, so its value depends only on the elements of X_j and the parity of S in each pair.

statement_nl:
Let a, b, r, j be integers with 0 <= a <= b, r >= 0, and j >= 0. Set I := {a+1, a+2, ..., b}. Define X_j to be the set of all pairs (S, lambda) such that S is a subset of I, lambda is a finite multiset of elements of I, and wt(lambda) + sum_{s in S}(r+s) = j, where wt(lambda) is the sum of the elements of lambda. Then X_j is finite. If E_j is the number of elements (S,lambda) in X_j with |S| even and O_j is the number of elements (S,lambda) in X_j with |S| odd, then
sum_{(S,lambda) in X_j} (-1)^{|S|} = E_j - O_j.
